Name: (AT) Shipping Bin Recolors
Author: OfInstrumentals
Description:
This is an Alternative Textures-version of my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33810]Shipping Bin Recolors[/url]﻿, but while this is not a full replacement for it this version should have less compatibility issues with other mods. I tried to make enough color combinations to make this mod worthwhile. If you notice any issues please let me know and I will try to fix it as soon as I can.

[b]What this mod does[/b]
You can choose from 46 color options for the Shipping Bin and 36 options for the Mini Shipping Bin. Some of them have the inside of the bin a different color than the outside, which you can't see in the AT menus, but I have named all of them so that they are easier to differentiate. For example here are "BrownLight", "BrownLight WhiteInside" and "BrownLight PrismaticInside":

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6QAlKM6.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/P0J6eZk.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/l7mhQje.png[/img][b]

[/b]Unfortunately due to how Alternative Textures works the bins don't have proper animations (such as when throwing an item in).[b]

Requirements[/b]
SMAPI and Alternative Textures

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the file and drop the (AT) Shipping Bin Recolors-folder in to the Mods-folder.
